records.title: BAdam: A Memory Efficient Full Parameter Optimization Method for Large Language Models
records.reason: 一次本文を確認した。BAdam uses block-coordinate descent with Adam updates for full-parameter fine-tuning and fits Llama 3-8B/70B on limited GPUs. The savings are training-time optimizer memory and running time; it does not improve inference memory or serving.
